description: Estimate the 1H and 13C NMR spectrum of a structure in CDCl3: each peak's shift in ppm, the number of protons, multiplicity and J in Hz, and the atoms it comes from (numbered from 1 in input order). These are the same additive-increment estimates as the Lone Pair editor's NMR tool (Shoolery/Pretsch, Pascual–Meier–Simon, Grant–Paul), not a spectral database: expect roughly ±0.3 ppm for 1H and ±5 ppm for 13C. A peak from an environment with little reference data is marked confidence: low. Call this instead of searching the web for an estimate, and say the numbers are estimates. Not for measured spectra (cite the literature), pKa (use estimate_pka) or masses (use mass_spectrum or analyze).

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Short text that is valid SMILES (such as "CO") is read as SMILES, with a note, and not sent. Default false.

name: predict_nmr
title: Estimate 1H and 13C NMR
